channels <- c("Affiliate", "Mobile", "Paid Search", "Social Media")

<script>

});


function openProject(id) {
  const p = projects[id];
  if (!p) return;
  document.getElementById('detailContent').innerHTML = `
    <p style="font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#E8722A;font-weight:400;margin-bottom:0.5rem;">${p.icon} ${p.type}</p>
    <h3>${p.title}</h3>
    <div class="detail-meta">${p.tags.map(t=>`<span class="card-tag">${t}</span>`).join('')}</div>
    <div class="detail-section"><label>Data &amp; Source</label><p>${p.data}</p></div>
    <div class="detail-section"><label>Managerial Problem</label><p>${p.problem}</p></div>
    <div class="detail-section"><label>Target Audience</label><p>${p.audience}</p></div>
    <div class="detail-section"><label>Research Questions / Objectives</label><p>${p.questions}</p></div>
    <div class="detail-section"><label>Expected Business Impact</label><p>${p.impact}</p></div>
    <div class="detail-section"><label>Methods</label><p>${p.methods}</p></div>
  `;
  document.getElementById('projectDetail').classList.add('open');
}

function closeProject() { document.getElementById('projectDetail').classList.remove('open'); }
document.getElementById('projectDetail').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (e.target === this) closeProject();
});
</script>

```{r dashboard-plots, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
make_b64 <- function(plot_obj, w = 6, h = 3.5) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  ggsave(tmp, plot = plot_obj, width = w, height = h, dpi = 120, bg = "white")
  b64 <- base64enc::base64encode(tmp)
  unlink(tmp)
  paste0('<img src="data:image/png;base64,', b64,
         '" style="width:100%;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:1rem;" />')
}

# Chart 1 — First Touch vs Last Touch
comparison_df <- data.frame(
  method  = rep(c("First Touch","Last Touch","Markov Chain"), each=4),
  channel = rep(channels, times=3),
  value   = c(0.254,0.418,0.209,0.119, 0.388,0.224,0.269,0.119, 0.260,0.245,0.238,0.257)
)
p1 <- ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x=method, y=value, fill=channel)) +
  geom_col(position="fill", width=0.65) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=percent_format(accuracy=1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors4) +
  labs(title="First Touch vs Last Touch Attribution", x=NULL, y="Share of attribution credit", fill="Channel") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x=element_blank(), legend.position="bottom",
        plot.background=element_rect(fill="white",color=NA),
        plot.title=element_text(size=11,face="bold",color="#1C2B3A"))

# Chart 2 — Removal Effect
removal_df <- data.frame(channel=channels, drop=c(0.6483,0.6830,0.6747,0.6154))
p2 <- ggplot(removal_df, aes(x=reorder(channel,drop), y=drop, fill=channel)) +
  geom_col(width=0.6, show.legend=FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label=percent(drop,accuracy=0.1)), hjust=-0.15, size=3.2, fontface="bold") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=percent_format(), limits=c(0,0.82)) +
  labs(title="Markov Chain: Removal Effect", x=NULL, y="Drop in conversion probability") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(), plot.background=element_rect(fill="white",color=NA),
        plot.title=element_text(size=11,face="bold",color="#1C2B3A"))

# Chart 3 — Attribution Credits
credits_df <- data.frame(
  channel = rep(channels, times=4),
  method  = rep(c("First Touch","Last Touch","Markov","Shapley"), each=4),
  credits = c(34,21,16,12, 24,31,22,6, 21.4,21.6,20.5,19.5, 20.7,20.6,21.0,20.7)
)
p3 <- ggplot(credits_df, aes(x=channel, y=credits, fill=method)) +
  geom_col(position="dodge", width=0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c(clr_navy,clr_terra,clr_green,"#8172B3")) +
  labs(title="Attribution Credits by Method", x=NULL, y="Conversion credits", fill="Model") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x=element_blank(), legend.position="bottom",
        plot.background=element_rect(fill="white",color=NA),
        plot.title=element_text(size=11,face="bold",color="#1C2B3A"))

# Chart 4 — Shapley Values
shapley_df <- data.frame(channel=channels, value=c(0.2001,0.1962,0.1969,0.1973))
p4 <- ggplot(shapley_df, aes(x=reorder(channel,value), y=value, fill=channel)) +
  geom_col(width=0.55, show.legend=FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label=round(value,4)), hjust=-0.15, size=3.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors4) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,0.24)) +
  labs(title="Shapley Values (Avg Marginal Contribution)", x=NULL, y="Shapley value") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(), plot.background=element_rect(fill="white",color=NA),
        plot.title=element_text(size=11,face="bold",color="#1C2B3A"))

# Chart 5 — Path Length
set.seed(42)
path_df <- data.frame(
  quartile   = rep(c("Q1 (6-9)","Q2 (10-17)","Q3 (18-31)","Q4 (32-45)"), each=26),
  conversion = c(rbinom(26,1,0.69),rbinom(26,1,0.77),rbinom(26,1,0.84),rbinom(26,1,0.86))
) |> group_by(quartile) |> summarise(rate=mean(conversion), .groups="drop")
p5 <- ggplot(path_df, aes(x=quartile, y=rate, group=1)) +
  geom_line(color=clr_terra, linewidth=1.5) +
  geom_point(size=4, color=clr_navy) +
  geom_text(aes(label=percent(rate,accuracy=1)), vjust=-1, size=3.2, fontface="bold", color=clr_navy) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=percent_format(), limits=c(0.5,1)) +
  labs(title="Conversion Rate by Path Length Quartile", x="Path length quartile", y="Conversion rate") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
  theme(plot.background=element_rect(fill="white",color=NA),
        plot.title=element_text(size=11,face="bold",color="#1C2B3A"))

# Chart 6 — Touch Frequency
freq_df <- data.frame(channel=channels, pct=c(28.5,30.1,26.4,15.0))
p6 <- ggplot(freq_df, aes(x=reorder(channel,pct), y=pct, fill=channel)) +
  geom_col(width=0.55, show.legend=FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label=paste0(pct,"%")), hjust=-0.15, size=3.5, fontface="bold") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors4) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,38)) +
  labs(title="Channel Touch Frequency (All Users)", x=NULL, y="% of all touchpoints") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(), plot.background=element_rect(fill="white",color=NA),
        plot.title=element_text(size=11,face="bold",color="#1C2B3A"))

cat('<script>document.getElementById("dashboard-charts").innerHTML = `')
cat(make_b64(p1))
cat(make_b64(p2))
cat(make_b64(p3))
cat(make_b64(p4))
cat(make_b64(p5))
cat(make_b64(p6))
cat(paste0('`;', '<', '/script>'))
```
